design: C0 static faithful projection vs C1 adaptive compiler. Design A: memory=off both arms (isolates compilation). Serial, counterbalanced, conc=1, real `devin -p` (SWE-2 High).
honest_conclusion: Adaptive compilation produced materially SMALLER packets (exact -86%, test -91%) but did NOT reduce agent input tokens or steps on this small repo — agent cost is dominated by the fixed system prompt + verification reads, not packet bytes. Correctness non-inferior (20/20 both). Safe but no measured agent-work benefit in this cohort.
caveats: n=40 screening pilot (not the 240 full study)
input-token signal is noisy and prompt-dominated
packet-byte savings are real even if agent-token savings are not
